name: Airflow - Workspace Monitoring to include Apache Airflow logs from Airflow Job
description: Fabric Apache Airflow jobs provides a SaaS way to build Python-based Airflow DAGs in your Fabric workspace. With this new feature, you will now be able to easily view your runtime logs from Apache Airflow in the Fabric Workspace Monitoring view to build your own queries, reports, and dashboards.

result.nameEs: Airflow: registros de Apache Airflow en Workspace Monitoring
result.descriptionEs: Los registros de ejecución de los Apache Airflow jobs podrán consultarse en Workspace Monitoring de Fabric para crear consultas, informes y paneles propios.
